title: Memory–sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression

result.label: Memory–sample lower bounds for noiseless Gaussian regression
result.statement: For fixed A > 0, a one-pass learner with Ad^2 persistent bits needs (d (1/ )) noiseless Gaussian samples to recover a unit vector to angular error 0 1/10 with probability 2/3, uniformly in accuracy for large d . Computation and randomized updates are unrestricted, but output uses only the terminal state, stopping index and fresh randomness.
